SELECT distinct u.department, u.`position`, u.name, date_str attendanceDate, DATE_FORMAT(actual_start_work_time, '%H:%i') actualStartWorkTime, DATE_FORMAT(actual_end_work_time, '%H:%i') actualEndWorkTime, case when repair_type is not null then repair_type else case when `type` is null then 4 else `type` end end type, remark, (case when b.id is null then 1 else 0 end) as isWorkingDay, a.attendance_date, u.person_id FROM sys_all_date d join (select DISTINCT name, SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(department ORDER BY CASE WHEN position IS NOT NULL AND position != '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END), ',', 1) AS department, SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(position ORDER BY CASE WHEN position IS NOT NULL AND position != '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END), ',', 1) AS position, person_id from attendance_record where 1=1
and department LIKE concat('%',#{department},'%')
AND `position` LIKE concat('%',#{position},'%')
AND `name` LIKE concat('%',#{name},'%')
AND (actual_start_work_time IS NULL OR actual_end_work_time IS NULL OR actual_start_work_time > #{fixedStartWorkTime} OR actual_end_work_time < #{fixedEndWorkTime})
AND name in
#{name}
AND attendance_date >= #{lessAttendanceDate}
AND attendance_date <= #{moreAttendanceDate} group by name, person_id) u left join attendance_record a on d.date_str = a.attendance_date and a.person_id = u.person_id
and a.department LIKE concat('%',#{department},'%')
AND a.`position` LIKE concat('%',#{position},'%')
AND a.`name` LIKE concat('%',#{name},'%')
AND (a.actual_start_work_time IS NULL OR a.actual_end_work_time IS NULL OR a.actual_start_work_time > #{fixedStartWorkTime} OR a.actual_end_work_time < #{fixedEndWorkTime})
AND a.name in
#{name}
left join attendance_non_work_day b on d.date_str BETWEEN b.start_date and b.end_date where date_str < now()
and (b.id is null or (b.id is not null and a.actual_start_work_time is not null))
and b.id is null
and b.id is not null and a.actual_start_work_time is not null
AND date_str >= #{lessAttendanceDate}
AND date_str <= #{moreAttendanceDate}
AND ((case when repair_type is not null then repair_type =#{type} else `type` = #{type} end ) or a.attendance_date is null)
AND (case when repair_type is not null then repair_type =#{type} else `type` = #{type} end)
ORDER BY d.date_str DESC, u.person_id
limit #{page}, #{row}
